title: Free trials and subscriptions
description: Free trials are only free if you remember them — how to stay in charge of subscriptions.

body.heading: The trial trap
paragraphs: A free trial that asks for card details usually becomes a paid subscription automatically. That is not a trick if it is stated clearly — but it relies on you forgetting, and many of us do.
The moment you start a trial, set a reminder for two days before it ends. Decide then, with the reminder in front of you, whether it earned its price.

body.heading: Audit your subscriptions
paragraphs: Every few months, list every subscription and ask: Did I use this in the last month? Would I buy it again today at this price? Cancel the honest no's — you can usually rejoin in minutes if you miss them.
Check for duplicates too: two music services, three video apps, a storage plan you outgrew. Small monthly amounts are easy to ignore and expensive over a year.

body.heading: Keep a subscriptions note
paragraphs: One note with each service, its price, and its renewal date turns a fuzzy worry into a five-minute check. Future you will be grateful.

takeaway: Set a reminder the day you start a trial, and audit subscriptions every few months.
